title: Oklahoma National Guard deploys to Hurricane Harvey relief efforts
description: Package - Oklahoma National Guardsmen making up Task Force 179 are departing the Norman Armed Forces Reserve Center and heading to Austin, Texas, to help the Texas National Guard with Hurricane Harvey relief. Approximately 500 Guardsmen from the 45th Infantry Brigade Combat Team are deploying to “provide general security, distribution, maintenance and shelter operations.”
keywords: Oklahoma National Guard, Hurricane Harvey, OKNG2Harvey

transcript.text: - [Christopher] Oklahoma National Guardsmen
making up Task Force 179
are departing the Norman Armed Forces Reserve Center
and heading to Austin, Texas
to help the Texas National Guard
with Hurricane Harvey relief.
Approximately 500 Guardsmen from
the 45th Infantry Brigade Combat Team
are deploying to provide general security,
distribution, maintenance, and shelter operations.
- We could be there a week.
We could be there a month.
We could be there more.
We're prepared to stay there as long as they
decide to keep us there.
Really, once we get there, we'll be under the control
of Texas, and it'll be on them to determine
where to use us, how to use us, and how long to use us.
- [Christopher] The task force is comprised of Guardsmen
from all over Oklahoma.
Yesterday, Guardsmen packed and prepared their vehicles
for a long trip.
- I'm ready.
We've got probably everything we could need
and then some.
We've packed everything we could
possibly think of and extra.
So, I feel like we're ready.
- [Christopher] The Oklahoma National Guard is scheduled
to deploy about 1,500 more Guardsmen in the next few days.
Reporting for the Oklahoma National Guard
from Norman, Oklahoma, I'm Army Staff Sergeant
Christopher Bruce.
